assessment.rationale: No needle-free patch vaccine is licensed anywhere, so the Main KPI of 5,000,000,000 patch doses is far off, but the immunological case is largely made and that must be said plainly. A 2026 Pharmaceutics review reports a phase 1 influenza patch trial with antibody responses non-inferior to the comparator and successful self-application, a phase 1-2 measles-rubella patch trial in Gambian infants with 93 percent measles and 100 percent rubella seroconversion and no related serious adverse events, and dose sparing up to six-fold for influenza, polio and SARS-CoV-2 antigens (https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/search?query=%22microarray%20patch%22%20AND%20vaccine%20AND%20%28measles%20OR%20rubella%20OR%20influenza%29%20AND%20trial&format=json&pageSize=3&resultType=core). The registry confirms the stage: the most advanced patch vaccine study is a completed phase 1 high-density microarray patch H7N9 influenza vaccine in 267 adults, with a hepatitis B patch phase 1 in 40 not yet recruiting (https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies?query.intr=microarray+patch+vaccine&pageSize=15). That no phase 3 has run is shown by a 2024 paper that still proposes a measles-rubella patch phase 3 framework, among 136 records on patch regulation and implementation research (https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/search?query=%22microarray%20patches%22%20AND%20%28%22regulatory%22%20OR%20%22licensure%22%20OR%20%22WHO%22%29%20AND%20vaccine&format=json&pageSize=8&resultType=lite). Open source is absent at the product level: 91 GitHub repositories under microneedle are student simulations, sensors and firmware (https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q=microneedle&per_page=10&sort=stars). Honest limit: patch immunogenicity in phase 1-2 is published prior art and a task that only repeats it is a known answer; the open work is licensure, billion-dose manufacture and cold-chain-free field performance.

additionalSearches.query: microarray patch vaccine clinical trial results
additionalSearches.finding: A 2026 Pharmaceutics review reports a phase 1 influenza patch trial with non-inferior antibody responses and successful self-application, and a phase 1-2 measles-rubella patch trial in Gambian infants with 93 percent measles and 100 percent rubella seroconversion and no related serious adverse events, plus up to six-fold dose sparing. None of the records states that any patch vaccine is licensed.

The most advanced registered patch vaccine study is NCT06417853, a completed phase 1 high-density microarray patch H7N9 influenza vaccine in 267 participants; NCT06800131 is a phase 1 transdermal hepatitis B patch in 40, not yet recruiting. Nothing beyond phase 1 in the registry.

additionalSearches.query: microarray patch regulatory and licensure literature
additionalSearches.finding: 136 hits. A 2024 Vaccines paper still proposes a measles-rubella microarray patch phase III trial framework and a 2026 J Glob Health paper sets implementation-research priorities, which together show no pivotal trial has been run and no patch vaccine is licensed.

91 repositories, top-starred at 3 stars or fewer: skin-mechanics simulations, electrochemical sensing firmware, plant-leaf sensor patches, student drug-release models. No open-source patch vaccine product or manufacturing line.
